resources.string: Keeps Minimalist installed so its limits cannot be removed on impulse.
Turning this off removes the only thing stopping you from uninstalling Minimalist in a weak moment. Are you sure?
A once-or-twice daily summary of notifications that were held back.
Home, back and recent apps from a strip along the bottom edge.
Draws a thin strip along the bottom of the screen. Swipe up for home, tap or swipe right for back, hold or swipe left for recent apps. It reads nothing from the screen.
